{{Quote|My world was caught in the middle. We had little to offer either side. We were ''attacked'' mainly because the Republic chose to defend us.|Crys Taanzer, about Nadiem|<ref name="DarkTimes7" />}}
'''Nadiem''' was an [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located in the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]]. It was home to a population of [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]], including both [[Human/Legends|Humans]] and members of other [[Species/Legends|species]]. During the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]], it had little to offer either the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] or the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], yet the latter nevertheless launched an [[Battle of Nadiem|attack]] on it due to the former choosing to defend it. The Republic carried out evacuations of the planet's settlements, during which the local [[Crys Taanzer]] gave up her [[Gender/Legends|son]] [[Kennan Taanzer|Kennan]] for [[Jedi training/Legends|training]] as a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]], which allowed him to be granted priority evacuation off Nadiem.

The Confederacy's [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent his [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] to attack a [[Unidentified settlement (Nadiem)|main settlement]]; however, it was defeated by a Republic force [[Commanding officer/Legends|led]] by Jedi [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]] and [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]]. On the far side of the planet, during Grievous's escape from Nadiem, he severely injured [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'dard Tone]] and [[Death/Legends|killed]] his [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] [[Zephata'ru'tor]]. [[Standard year/Legends|Years]] later, both Taanzer and Tone would recall their experiences on Nadiem in conversations with others. In [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]], the [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] would also invoke Nadiem as part of a cover story told to a [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] border patrol for a [[Starship/Legends|starship]] smuggling operation he and his partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] were carrying out.

==Description==
Nadiem was a remote [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE Nadiem">{{CSWECite|II|355|Nadiem}}</ref> located in the [[Nadiem system/Legends|Nadiem system]], a part of the [[Baxel sector/Legends|Baxel sector]]<ref name="EAOC" /> in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of<ref name="TEA Nadiem" /> the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]].<ref name="EAOC" /> Its surface featured [[Mountain/Legends|mountains]] as well as areas of more level terrain covered with [[Grass/Legends|grass]] and [[Stone/Legends|rocks]].<ref name="Hide" />

The [[Threadneedle Canyon]] was a crescent-shaped, high-walled<ref name="CSWE Threadneedle Canyon">{{CSWECite|III|240|Threadneedle Canyon}}</ref> canyon on Nadiem with one vertical side, along which flowed a stream of [[Water/Legends|water]]. [[Bush/Legends|Shrubs]] grew on both sides of the canyon, with the more inclined side also being home to a type of small, [[Color/Legends|red]]-[[Fruit/Legends|fruited]] [[Tree/Legends|tree]] as well as a dark-green [[Lizard/Legends|lizard]] and a large [[Centipede/Legends|centipede]] of the same color. A type of flying creature also resided in the vicinity of the canyon.<ref name="Hide" />

==History==
===A world caught in the middle===
{{Quote|It was a few months after the war began. The Republic couldn't stop the droid attack. My husband was killed, our home &mdash; our ''whole village'' &mdash; was destroyed.|Crys Taanzer|<ref name="DarkTimes7" />}}
According to [[Crys Taanzer]], a Human resident of Nadiem, by the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the planet held little value for either of the opposing sides. Nevertheless, the Republic chose to defend Nadiem, which per Taanzer was the principal reason why the Confederacy launched an [[Battle of Nadiem|attack]]<ref name="DarkTimes7" />&mdash;which came to be known as the Battle of Nadiem<ref name="CSWE Zephata'ru'tor">{{CSWECite|III|371|Zephata'ru'tor}}</ref>&mdash;on the world<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="HideDate">''[[Star Wars: The Comics Companion]]'' dates the events of "[[Hide in Plain Sight]]," which depicts the [[Battle of Nadiem]], to twenty-two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to those of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> five [[Standard month/Legends|months]] into the conflict.<ref name="CSWE Nadiem" />

[[File:CrysAndKennanSeparated-DarkTimes7.jpg|thumb|right|300px|A Jedi Padawan takes Crys Taanzer's son Kennan aboard a Galactic Republic evacuation transport on Nadiem while a Ho'Din Jedi, consoling Taanzer, observes.]]
The fierce advance of the Confederacy's [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid army]] forced<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> Republic evacuation of Nadiem's settlements.<ref name="Hide" /><ref name="DarkTimes7" /> [[Unidentified Nadiem village|Taanzer's village]] was destroyed, with<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> her<ref name="CSWE Crys Taanzer">{{CSWECite|III|209|Taanzer, Crys}}</ref> [[Crys Taanzer's husband|husband]] being [[Death/Legends|killed]]. During the subsequent evacuation amid a pitched Republic defense effort, a [[Unidentified Ho'Din Jedi|Ho'Din healer]] of the Republic's [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and his Human [[Unidentified Human Padawan|Padawan]] learned that Taanzer's Human [[Gender/Legends|son]], [[Kennan Taanzer|Kennan]], possessed [[Force-sensitive/Legends|sensitivity]] to [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. The [[Ho'Din/Legends|Ho'Din]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] offered to take Kennan in for [[Jedi training/Legends|Jedi training]], which would allow him to designate the [[Youngling/Legends|boy]] for priority evacuation and ensure his arrival on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]],<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> the Republic's [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] planet,<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> within the span of two [[Standard day/Legends|days]]. The heartbroken Taanzer gave up her son, who was then taken by the Ho'Din's [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] aboard a newly arrived Republic evacuation [[Low Altitude Assault Transport/infantry/Legends|transport]]. Only moments after the craft's departure, the Republic positions were overrun by Confederate [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droids]], causing everyone, including Taanzer, to flee, and leading to the demise of the Ho'Din Jedi, who attempted to ward off the [[Droid/Legends|droids]].<ref name="DarkTimes7" />

===Grievous's command===
{{Quote|On Vantos, Nadiem, and dozens of other worlds, Grievous slaughtered clone troopers and civilians alike, collecting lightsaber trophies from the Jedi Knights whom he beheaded.|A Galactic Alliance historical document|<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref>}}
[[File:Nadiem.jpg|thumb|left|300px|General Grievous commanded a droid attack on a main settlement (pictured) on Nadiem.]]
Issuing orders from a command post located in territory on Nadiem under the Confederacy's control,<ref name="Hide" /> the [[Kaleesh/Legends|Kaleesh]] [[Cyborg/Legends|cyborg]]<ref name="Insider86">{{InsiderCite|86|Unknown Soldier: The Story of General Grievous}}</ref> [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] sent the droid [[Army/Legends|army]] to attack a [[Unidentified settlement (Nadiem)|main settlement]], with the force marching through the Threadneedle Canyon on its approach. Meanwhile, a [[Blockade/Legends|blockade]] set up by a Republic [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] led by General [[Saesee Tiin/Legends|Saesee Tiin]] repelled the Confederate [[Fighter Wing Zero-Zero]], thereby preventing it from providing [[Atmosphere/Legends|air]] support to the droid army. Ultimately, the army engaged a Republic force based at the settlement and under the [[Commanding officer/Legends|command]] of the [[Mirialan/Legends|Mirialan]] [[Senior Jedi General|Jedi General]] [[Luminara Unduli/Legends|Luminara Unduli]]. With the help of a [[Advance Squad|squad]] of [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] led by Unduli's Mirialan Padawan [[Barriss Offee/Legends|Barriss Offee]],<ref name="Hide" /> the Republic force was able to defeat the droid army, liberating the local settlers.<ref name="CSWE Nadiem" />

Grievous subsequently moved to escape Nadiem in his [[Soulless One/Legends|personal starfighter]], although [[Coway]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[B'dard Tone]] and his [[Duinuogwuin/Legends|Duinuogwuin]] Padawan [[Zephata'ru'tor]]<ref name="Insider86" /> first attempted to confront him on the far side of the planet from the Threadneedle Canyon battle.<ref name="CSWE Nadiem" /> Grievous, however, killed Zephata'ru'tor in [[Realspace/Legends|space]] above Nadiem during his escape and severely injured Tone, forcing the Coway to adopt [[Cybernetics/Legends|cybernetic]] body part replacements.<ref name="Insider86" /> Nadiem had thus become one among a number of worlds where Grievous had slaughtered Republic [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] [[Trooper/Legends|troopers]] and civilians alike.<ref name="NEC" /> The war eventually moved on to other worlds, and Nadiem and its surviving inhabitants were largely forgotten by the wider [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. Crys Taanzer later found employment offworld<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> as a [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] of the [[Maka-Eekai L4000 transport|transport]] ''[[Uhumele]]''.<ref name="CSWE Crys Taanzer" />

===After the war moved on===
{{Quote|The vessel ''is'' Corellian, en route to Nadiem, a smallish farming colony on the Rim.|Raprice|<ref name="Tales2">{{Tales|2|Routine}}</ref>}}
In [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="ToneDate">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: General Grievous]]'', which includes those of [[General Grievous 1|''General Grievous'' 1]], to [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]].</ref> Tone noted the losses he had suffered at Nadiem during a conversation with the Human Padawan [[Flynn Kybo]].<ref name="GeneralGrievous1">[[General Grievous 1|''General Grievous'' 1]]</ref> The [[19 BBY/Legends|following year]],<ref name="BomoDate">{{DarkHorse|url=Zones/StarWars/Timeline|text=Comics Timeline}} established that the events of ''[[Star Wars: Dark Times: Parallels]]'', which includes those of [[Dark Times 7|''Dark Times'' 7]], are set nineteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}}, which corresponds to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''. Furthermore, in ''Dark Times'' 7 [[Crys Taanzer]] mentions [[Operation: Knightfall/Legends|Operation: Knightfall]], which {{Film|III}} depicts as taking place at the same time as the issuance of [[Order 66/Legends|Order 66]]. ''Dark Times'' 7 is set directly after [[Dark Times 6|''Dark Times'' 6]], the present-day events of which take place two [[Standard month/Legends|months]] after Order 66 was issued.</ref> Crys Taanzer similarly relayed her separation from Kennan on Nadiem to the ''Uhumule''{{'s}} [[Nosaurian/Legends|Nosaurian]] crewmember [[Bomo Greenbark]]. Since she had learned<ref name="DarkTimes7" /> approximately two months earlier<ref name="BomoDate" /> of the supposed [[Great Jedi Purge/Legends|extermination]] of all Jedi, Crys believed her decision on Nadiem had only served to ensure her son's death&mdash;although, unbeknownst to her, Kennan had, in fact, escaped the demise that had befallen other Jedi and was still alive at the time of the conversation.<ref name="DarkTimes7" />

[[File:JainasLight-Tales2.jpg|thumb|right|300px|One of three CR90 corvettes that Han Solo claimed to a Galactic Empire border patrol that he was using to transport goods to Nadiem.]]
The Human [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and his [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] partner [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] underwent a venture<ref name="Tales2" /> in [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]]<ref name="RoutineDate">{{Tales|2|Routine}} is set [[Standard year/Legends|years]] prior to the events of {{Film|IV}} and during the existence of the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]], which corresponds to [[2 BBY/Legends|2 BBY]] per ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> where they successively transported three virtually identical [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvettes]] to [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]],<ref name="Tales2" /> a planet in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]],<ref name="TEA" /> for sale to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]].<ref name="CSWE Jaina's Light">{{CSWECite|II|134|''Jaina's Light''}}</ref> To the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Carrack-class light cruiser/Legends|''Carrack''-class light cruiser]] [[Vigilant (Carrack-class)|''Vigilant'']], which encountered each of the [[Corvette/Legends|corvettes]] while performing border patrol, Solo instead claimed that it was the same [[Starship/Legends|vessel]], named [[Jaina's Light/Legends|''Jaina's Light'']]. Furthermore, according to Solo's story, [[Farmer/Legends|farmers]] on Nadiem had loaned him the [[Currency/Legends|money]] to purchase the corvette in exchange for him making relatively small deliveries of [[Grain/Legends|grain]], [[Seed/Legends|seeds]], and other goods to their world.<ref name="Tales2" />

Ultimately, it was only after Solo and Chewbacca's third run that it registered with the ''Vigilant''{{'s}} [[Captain/Legends|captain]], [[Deyd Llnewe]], that they had yet to encounter the corvette on its way to pick up its supposed cargo, with the captain thereby realizing the smugglers' ruse.<ref name="Tales2" /> Grievous' actions on Nadiem during the Clone Wars were later briefly mentioned in the [[36 ABY]] [[Galaxy/Legends|galactic]] history [[The New Essential Chronology (in-universe)|chronicle]] by the [[Historical Council]] of the [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances]].<ref name="NEC" />

==Inhabitants==
{{Quote|But it was the farmers on ''Nadiem'' who loaned me the money to buy this ship&hellip; in exchange for my making these piddling little runs for them.|Han Solo|<ref name="Tales2" />}}
Nadiem was inhabited by a [[Colonist/Legends|colony]] of<ref name="CSWE Nadiem" /> [[Galactic Basic Standard/Legends|Galactic Basic Standard]]&ndash;speaking<ref name="Hide" /> [[Farm/Legends|farming]]<ref name="CSWE Nadiem" /> population that included [[Human/Legends|Humans]] as well as members of other [[Species/Legends|species]], including at least one [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorian]]. During the Clone Wars, at least two residents of a main settlement on the planet owned domesticated animals, respectively an [[Elrod|eopi]] and a relatively large [[Rat/Legends|rat]]-like creature. In addition, an outdoor [[Merchant/Legends|merchant's]] stall displayed a number of dead reddish-skinned, blue-[[Eye/Legends|eyed]], green-[[Tongue/Legends|tongued]] [[Limb/Legends|tetrapods]].<ref name="Hide" /> Nearly two [[Standard decade/Legends|decades]] later, after the smuggler Han Solo had falsely claimed to the Imperial [[Light cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] ''Vigilant'' that he was transporting goods to Nadiem, the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser's]] [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]] [[Raprice]] characterized the world as a "smallish" colony to his captain.<ref name="Tales2" />

==Locations==
{{Quote|We've overtaken a group of refugees from one of the outlying settlements.|An [[Unidentified ARC commander (Nadiem)|Advanced Recon Commando trooper]], in a communication to Luminara Unduli|<ref name="Hide" />}}
At one end, Nadiem's Threadneedle Canyon leveled out into a valley that housed a main settlement. The latter was bordered by a stream of water that ran in a perpendicular direction to the canyon and into which flowed the stream traversing the canyon. There were also several outlying settlements, including a village that was connected to the main settlement via a road leading through the Threadneedle Canyon.<ref name="Hide" />

==Behind the scenes==
Nadiem was first mentioned in "[[Routine]]," a [[Star Wars comic books|comic story]] written by [[Tony Isabella]] and published in<ref name="Tales2" /> the [[January 5]], [[2000]]<ref name="DH">{{DarkHorse|url=Comics/97-291/Star-Wars-Tales-2|text=Star Wars Tales #2}}</ref> [[Star Wars Tales 2|second issue]] of [[Dark Horse Comics]]' ''[[Star Wars Tales]]'' series of anthology comic-books.<ref name="Tales2" /> It then made its first full appearance in "[[Hide in Plain Sight]]," a comic story written by [[Randy Stradley|Welles Hartley]], penciled by the [[Fillbach Brothers]], and published by Dark Horse Comics<ref name="Hide" /> on [[Free Comic Book Day]] on [[July 3]], [[2004]].<ref name="FCBD2004">{{WebCite|url=https://freecomicbookday.com/Article/189955-FCBD-2004-Spider-Man-Archie-Teen-Titans-Mickey-Mouse-and-Star-Wars|text=FCBD 2004: Spider-Man, Archie, Teen Titans, Mickey Mouse, and Star Wars!|author=[[Wikipedia:Diamond Comic Distributors|Diamond Comic Distributors]]|archivedate=20251114050123}}</ref> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the Nadiem [[Star system/Legends|system]], and thereby Nadiem itself, in grid square U-11.<ref name="TEA Nadiem" />
